snippet.title: Epi-Derick Trailer
snippet.description:
Title: 
Epi-Derick | Official Release Date Trailer

Video Description: 

In a remote UK town, a strange disease has left every resident identical.
You are the only pharmacist. Their survival depends on your prescriptions.

Epi-Derick releases October 7th. 
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2178890/EpiDerick/ 

Fireslug Studios is a UK-based indie team with a taste for the unusual. We turn absurd ideas into games with a lot of character, sometimes at the gentle insistence of our mascot, Sluggy. Our debut game, Epi-Derick, releases October 7th. Follow along to see what other tributes we’re preparing.
